rationale: C25 is a highly specific precedent for the child: both concern further exemption of a named Interstate Commerce Commission member from compulsory retirement for age after an earlier exemption tied to the member's current term. They use substantially parallel public-interest findings and the same exemption machinery, with the child adapting the template to Aitchison's impending term expiration and statutory holdover service. C02 and C08 share the retirement-exemption form, but lack C25's distinctive ICC and term-of-office correspondence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Clyde B. Aitchison, a member of the Interstate Commerce Commission, was by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... exempted from compulsory retirement for age for an indefinite period of time not extending beyond the duration of his appointment or term of office
shared_material.parent_excerpt: John Monroe Johnson, a member of the Interstate Commerce Commission, who was exempted by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... from compulsory retirement for age for an indefinite period of time not extending beyond the expiration of his present term of office
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel identifying an ICC commissioner, a prior exemption from age retirement, and an exemption duration limited by the commissioner's term.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that the said Clyde B. Aitchison be further exempted from compulsory retirement for age as provided below.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that John Monroe Johnson ... be further exempted from such retirement for age as provided below
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical public-interest finding and operative setup for a further exemption.

shared_material.child_excerpt: his term of office will expire on December 31, 1949 ... a Commissioner ... shall continue to serve until his successor is appointed and shall have qualified
shared_material.parent_excerpt: not extending beyond the expiration of his present term of office ... be further exempted from such retirement for age
shared_material.explanation: The child elaborates the same term-expiration problem handled by C25, adapting it to Aitchison's statutory holdover status.
